description: React Native component for item detail screen in a food delivery app, handling item customization, variation selection, add-ons, and cart interactions.

methods.name: validateButton
methods.description: Validates if the current selection of variation and addons meets the required constraints.

methods.name: onPressAddToCart
methods.description: Handles adding the item to the cart, including validation, analytics tracking, and navigation.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds the selected item with options and addons to the cart, or updates existing cart items.

methods.name: onSelectVariation
methods.description: Updates the selected variation and its associated addons.

methods.name: calculatePrice
methods.description: Calculates total price based on selected variation and addons.

methods.name: validateOrderItem
methods.description: Validates if the current order item has valid addon selections.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders either radio or checkbox component based on addon quantity constraints.
